## *Biederer joins Reservoir’s roster through its joint venture with independent publisher superreal* ****


Reservoir Media, Inc. (NASDAQ: RSVR), an award-winning independent music company, today announced a new publishing deal with singer-songwriter Riley Biederer for her catalog and future works. Biederer joins Reservoir’s roster through its joint venture with independent music publisher superreal, which has represented Biederer since 2024.


Based in Los Angeles and Nashville, Biederer is a standout lyricist and vocalist. As a teenager performing in Nashville, she caught the attention of Elton John and signed to his management company Rocket Music, before appearing as a contestant on the hit singing contest show, *The Voice* . Biederer made it to the Top 20 of the show, after which she supported Nick Carter on tour across North America. Her breakout collab, “Heartbreak Back” with DJ Frank Walker, was released in 2018 and was a long-running Canadian Top 10 hit (over 30 weeks), while peaking at #20 on Billboard’s Dance Club Songs chart and earning a remix by R3HAB. Biederer has also been a featured vocalist on “Throw Away My Number” by Jordie Ireland and “forever, for now” by Syence. Most recently, her solo releases have included “Under My Breath” and its subsequent remixes, as well as her 2026 single “you already know” in collaboration with Sody.


Outside of her own artist project, Biederer has collaborated with other artists, such as Avery Anna, Carter Faith, Dustin Lynch, Priscilla Block, Ava Hall, Ethan Burdick, Elizabeth Nichols, Ingrid Andress, Adrien Nunez, Macy Todd, Summer Overstreet, and Tigirlily Gold, as well as songwriters, including Emily Weisband, Tofer Brown, Alysa Vanderheym, Jon Decious, Jon Nite, and Geoff Warburton. She was notably selected this year as a 2026 AIMP Songwriter Series winner. Biederer notably has penned music with some of country’s biggest names, and recent songwriting credits include “Tumbleweeds and Chewing Gum” by Lily Meola and Willie Nelson, “Roses & Wildfire” by Lanie Gardner, “It Takes Two” and “Break My Heart Again” by Danielle Bradbery, “Family Reunion” by Paige Fish, and Priscilla Block’s recent single “Maybe Next Time, Honey!,” among others.


Biederer commented, “I’m so excited to be entering this next chapter with my superreal crew by adding Reservoir to the family! For as long as I can remember, I’ve loved music like nothing else, and I feel incredibly grateful to have a group of people alongside me and championing my craft who feel the same joy and passion for songs that I do. I truly feel like I’ve lucked out with such a dream team, and I can’t wait to see what we do together.”


Vice President, Head of A&R at superreal Josh Toll also commented, “When we signed Riley to superreal, we were immediately struck by her lyricism and ability to tell memorable stories through song. We’ve always been intentional about keeping the superreal roster selective and going all-in on writers who have something truly special, and Riley immediately felt like someone worth making that kind of bet on. As Riley continues to grow, particularly within Nashville and country music, we wanted to build an environment where that evolution could continue while bringing in another exceptional team. Reservoir is the right partner for that next chapter, and we’re excited to be working with them.”


Reservoir Executive Vice President of Creative John Ozier added, “Riley is a versatile songwriter and artist, with a strong creative voice and an impressive network of collaborators across genres. She is a great asset to the growing country music community in Los Angeles, while her adaptability gives her the opportunity to work well beyond the country space. With Reservoir’s global team and reach across Nashville, Los Angeles, New York, and beyond, we’re excited to connect Riley to new creative opportunities and collaborators across our network. We’re thrilled to be working alongside superreal to support Riley as she continues to build on all that she’s already accomplished.”
